'''Bams''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] who worked for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the group's leader on the ground, [[Dors Stelikag]], ordered Bams to contact one of their companions, [[Kofter]], via the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], unaware that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had already [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.<ref name="Choices" />
